title: 공증사무 이의신청사건의 처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Investigation of Objection Case)
(1) The prosecutor in charge shall investigate whether the handling of affairs by the notary public concerned violated statutes and regulations concerning notarization and whether such affairs were handled properly.
(2) For the purpose of investigating an objection case, the prosecutor in charge may hear statements from the notary public concerned and the notary's assistant, or from the client or interested person, and may examine relevant documents.
(3) Where the prosecutor in charge discovers suspicion of a crime in the course of investigating an objection case, the prosecutor shall commence an investigation pursuant to the Criminal Procedure Act separately from the handling of the objection case.
